Chat request with seed parameter for deterministic output; response includes system_fingerprint

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use Liter\Llm\LiterLlm;
use Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest;
$req = \Liter\Llm\ChatCompletionRequest::from_json(json_encode(["messages" => [["content" => "Pick a random number", "role" => "user"]], "model" => "gpt-4", "seed" => 42]));
$result = LiterLlm::chat($req);
var_dump($result->getChoices());
var_dump($result->getChoices()[0]->finishReason);
var_dump($result->systemFingerprint);
```
